sun in astrology: The Sun (Surya) represents the soul (Atma), father, authority, government, self-esteem, willpower, and vitality. It rules Leo (Simha).
moon in astrology: The Moon (Chandra) governs the mind (Manas), emotions, subconscious patterns, mother, nurturing, and mental peace. It rules Cancer (Karka).
mars in astrology: Mars (Mangal) represents courage, energy, physical strength, ambition, real estate, and leadership. It rules Aries (Mesha) and Scorpio (Vrishchika).
mercury in astrology: Mercury (Budha) rules intellect, communication, logic, mathematics, trade, and nervous system. It rules Gemini (Mithuna) and Virgo (Kanya).
jupiter in astrology: Jupiter (Guru/Brihaspati) represents wisdom, spirituality, dharma, wealth, guru, children, and divine grace. It rules Sagittarius (Dhanu) and Pisces (Meena).
venus in astrology: Venus (Shukra) represents love, beauty, art, luxury, vehicles, romance, and marriage. It rules Taurus (Vrishabha) and Libra (Tula).
saturn in astrology: Saturn (Shani) represents karma, discipline, hard work, longevity, delays, detachment, and justice. It rules Capricorn (Makara) and Aquarius (Kumbha).
rahu in astrology: Rahu (North Lunar Node) represents illusion (Maya), worldly ambition, foreign elements, technology, innovation, and sudden events.
ketu in astrology: Ketu (South Lunar Node) represents spiritual liberation (Moksha), detachment, occult knowledge, introspection, and past-life karma.
pitra dosha remedies: Pitra Dosha remedies include performing Tarpan and Pind Daan during Pitru Paksha, feeding cows, birds, and fish, and reciting the Pitru Gayatri Mantra.
shani shanti: To appease Saturn (Shani), light a mustard oil diya under a Peepal tree on Saturdays, feed black dogs, chant 'Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah', and donate black sesame or blankets.
surya arghya: Surya Arghya involves offering clean water from a copper vessel to the rising Sun while reciting 'Om Suryaya Namah' to boost health, confidence, and vitality.
